origin.summary: User requested an architect for replacing in-memory/direct registration and repository artifact metadata storage with a SQL-backed store that preserves deleted tools as records marked deleted and captures extensible tool metadata such as SHA-256, tool name, tool type, and future fields.

events.note: Created as a pending design/implementation package for durable SQL-backed tool, registration, artifact, publication, and deletion metadata.
Linked to repository review, scanner pipeline, publication trust, runtime install hardening, and fake-scanner cleanup records as the durable metadata foundation.
Activated as the next foundation objective; implementation remains gated on user approval after the property-driven SQL plan is reviewed.
Resolved the first repository SQL metadata-store slice with property-driven SQL table identity, a metadata-store interface, SQL implementation, and focused verification.
